import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g = 1-np.exp(-0.17152542*t**1.28571428)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*g + params[2]*t + params[3]*g*t
            + params[4]*P + params[5]*t*P + params[6]*P**2 + params[7]*g*P**2
            + params[8]*g*P + params[9]*g*P**3)
